@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@ histlog is organized as a small set of Elixir modules around the NDJSON file bou
 * `Histlog.Schema` validates event shape and session sequence numbers.
 * `Histlog.Storage` owns filesystem layout, atomic writes, and quarantine moves.
 * `Histlog.Database.Schema` owns the native SQLite schema.
+* `Histlog.Database.Projection` writes normalized SQLite projection rows.
 * `Histlog.SessionWriter` writes one append-only live session file.
 * `Histlog.Consolidator` materializes closed sessions into `histlog.db`.
 * `Histlog.Import` parses external shell history into synthetic event streams.
